answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in pearl and glacier lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the oasis graph. A farm of 3301 identities would post 1672 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
